Domino Data Lab builds AI solutions for highly regulated organizations, combining model and app development, hosting, and governance capabilities. The Forward Deployed Engineer will work directly with customers to identify AI adoption challenges and build mission-critical solutions using applied AI and software engineering. The role involves designing systems, writing code, and delivering solutions across healthcare, life sciences, finance, and government.

Responsibilities
Work directly with customers to uncover some of the largest challenges to AI adoption in highly regulated industries, and learn how to leverage the Domino platform to build solutions for mission-critical business operations
Partner with experienced FDEs to move quickly from an ambiguous customer problem to a real solution, whether that means a RAG pipeline, an agentic workflow with automated evaluation, or a software solution that automates a customer's internal processes
Write code, design systems end to end, and deliver impact in high stakes environments from healthcare and life sciences to finance, government and beyond

Required
“Act fast, own it” mentality: We move fast, and need people who are driven, motivated, and bold
Passion for AI/data engineering, software engineering, large language models, and real world applications
Proficiency in Python is required
Exposure to building applied AI systems such as RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, or model evaluation, through coursework, internships, or personal projects
Comfort picking up container concepts such as Docker and Kubernetes, and basic familiarity with a cloud provider such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
Strong communication and problem solving skills, with an interest in customer facing work
Graduating in Spring 2027, pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field
Visa sponsorship (including H-1B and other employment-based visa categories) may be available for this position depending on business considerations and the role's requirements. Sponsorship eligibility is assessed on an individual basis and is not guaranteed for any role or candidate. All applicants are encouraged to apply regardless of current or future immigration status
Preferred
additional experience with R, Java, or C/C++ is a plus
Benefits
This role may be eligible for a sign-on bonus and/or relocation assistance, which are not reflected in the salary range listed below.
Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.
